items.title: British Museum sells second set of Bayeux exhibition tickets
items.description: The medieval artwork depicting the 1066 Norman invasion of England in painstaking detail is on an unprecedented loan from France and will be exhibited at the museum until July 11, 2027.

items.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine on Trump's turn toward Russia
items.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine John Herbst about President Trump's embrace of Russia as envoy Steve Witkoff heads to Moscow after meeting Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: Kremlin Rejects Energy Ceasefire But Says Full Peace Deal Requires Ukraine’s Participation
items.description: The Kremlin’s spokesperson said Putin is not considering an energy ceasefire with Ukraine but added that a full resolution of the war requires Ukrainian officials’ participation. Peskov also dismissed recent European peace proposals as unlikely to contribute constructively to a settlement.

items.title: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard during Witkoff talks
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with US special envoy Steve Witkoff in St. Petersburg for talks about a Ukraine peace deal. During the talks, Putin announced that jailed American Stephen Hubbard had been released.
